title: UPSSSC PET Online Form 2026
organization: Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission
vacancyDetails: UPSSSC PET is a qualifying exam required for many Group C recruitments; not a post-specific vacancy
qualification: As per UPSSSC PET notification (generally Intermediate / as specified)
applicationFee: As per UPSSSC PET fee rules
selectionProcess: Online Application → PET Written Exam → Scorecard for future recruitments
documentsRequired: Photo, signature, educational details, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Complete UPSSSC OTR if required
2. Visit https://upsssc.gov.in
3. Open PET 2026 Apply Online
4. Fill form, pay fee and submit
5. Print application
shortDescription: UPSSSC PET Online Form 2026 open. Apply for Preliminary Eligibility Test at upsssc.gov.in.
content:
UPSSSC has released the Preliminary Eligibility Test (PET) Online Form 2026.

PET score is used as a shortlisting criterion for various UPSSSC Group-C posts. Apply only through the official website within the notified dates.
